Type: implementation task
Work key: CX01.3
Epic: CX (core curation flow and console polish)
Source: console walkthrough 2026-10-15 (demo data, 1440x900 and 390x844)

Scope: Prove the loop end to end with PostgreSQL.

Acceptance criteria:
1. Rehearsal stage: TR mismatch finding → Fix → reason → preview shows the mismatch resolved → accept → new head no longer reports it.
2. Rehearsal stage: EventsOutsideWindow → Fix → edit flagged rows → accept.
3. A suggestion made stale by a concurrent acceptance goes through the existing conflict recovery without losing the other edit.

Verification: `bash scripts/check-console-backend.sh` with the new stages; receipt and screenshots refreshed.

Starting code:
- tests/console/rehearsal.js
- modules/http/src/test/scala (ConsoleRehearsal)
